metadata.case_name: NG SIK KAI v. LUI WING LOK T/A WING WAH OIL SHIP CO.

plaintiff.occupation_before: deckhand on the defendant’s fuel barge (Yue Tai)
plaintiff.occupation_after: service attendant at Tuen Mun Hospital

injuries.description: 2cm laceration over near the right ear and a scalp haematoma at the back of the head
injuries.body_part: right ear; back of head; scalp
source: The plaintiff was taken to Queen Mary Hospital A&E with a 2cm laceration over near the right ear and a scalp haematoma at the back of the head, with tenderness on left shoulder. He was fully conscious with no neurological deficit. CT scan showed no intracranial lesion. He was treated with suturing of the laceration.
injuries.icd_description: Laceration without foreign body of head

injuries.description: Fracture of the right temporal bone and right lateral wall of the sphenoid sinus
injuries.body_part: right temporal bone; right lateral wall of the sphenoid sinus
source: CT performed on 28 October 2013 showed fracture of the right temporal bone and right lateral wall of the sphenoid sinus.
injuries.icd_description: Other fractures of base of skull

injuries.description: Right facial nerve palsy causing incomplete right eye closure, treated with artificial tears and eye padding
injuries.body_part: right facial nerve / face / right eye
source: He later developed right facial nerve palsy and was transferred to the ENT department. The facial nerve palsy caused incomplete right eye closure so he was treated with artificial tears and eye padding.
the plaintiff still has mild right facial nerve palsy (with paresis and involuntary twitching of right facial muscles)...
blurred vision, dryness and irritation of the right eye.

injuries.description: Right and left hearing impairment (binaural hearing impairment of 2.8%), mild tinnitus and dizziness
source: The ENT experts agreed that the accident caused his right and left hearing impairment (binaural hearing impairment of 2.8%), mild tinnitus, dizziness and mild facial nerve impairment.
the plaintiff still has ... right-sided hearing loss with intermittent tinnitus...
injuries.icd_description: Injury of middle or inner ear

injuries.description: Post-concussional syndrome (intermittent headaches, dizziness, subjective impairment of memory, irritability and insomnia)
source: the plaintiff still has mild right facial nerve palsy (with paresis and involuntary twitching of right facial muscles), right-sided hearing loss with intermittent tinnitus and post-concussional syndrome (intermittent headaches, dizziness, subjective impairment of memory, irritability and insomnia), blurred vision, dryness and irritation of the right eye.
The neurological experts agreed that he had suffered a mild head injury.

manifestations.description: Scalp haematoma at the back of the head
Incomplete right eye closure (exposure keratopathy treated with eye lubricants)
Mild right facial nerve palsy with paresis and involuntary twitching of right facial muscles
Dryness and irritation of the right eye

losses.description: the plaintiff still has mild right facial nerve palsy (with paresis and involuntary twitching of right facial muscles), right-sided hearing loss with intermittent tinnitus and post-concussional syndrome (intermittent headaches, dizziness, subjective impairment of memory, irritability and insomnia), blurred vision, dryness and irritation of the right eye.
